administrative_process_required: Year-end MAGI determination at tax filing; match computed after return processed; Treasury deposit 'as soon as practicable' (one-year lag behind contributions)

population: Sub-cap eligibles (match < $1,000; match moves dollar-for-dollar with MAGI realization)
administrative_process_required: Full true-up: every dollar of difference between payroll-period income and filed MAGI changes the match; median exposure $32 per $1,000 MAGI revision (p75 $47)

population: Cap-binding eligibles (match = $1,000; locally insensitive to MAGI news)
administrative_process_required: No marginal true-up needed unless MAGI revision is large enough to unbind the cap; simplest cohort to administer

population: Near-endpoint eligibles (MAGI within $2,000 of the zero-match endpoint)
administrative_process_required: Cliff-adjacent: a modest MAGI surprise (bonus, second job, spouse earnings) zeroes the match; full clawback/denial processing after contributions were already deposited

population: Self-employed eligibles in the universal account (no payroll rail)
administrative_process_required: No employer withholding: contributions must flow via quarterly estimated-tax rails or annual reconciliation; income observed only at filing - both sides of min(rate x contrib, $1,000) unknown until April

population: All participating eligibles: section 6433(d)(2) distribution recapture
administrative_process_required: 3-year lookback netting prior distributions against qualified contributions (simulation does not model this); requires cross-plan, cross-year information returns (1099-R matching) before any match is paid

population: Non-eligible auto-enrolled defaulters (account servicing only, no match)
administrative_process_required: Account opening, payroll remittance, statements, opt-out processing - no match reconciliation, but full recordkeeping cost
